content:
Benjamin and Chance discuss their HomeView experiences and Siri reliability issues after a week of the product being in the world. Benjamin also tests the new Apple TV surround sound feature. And the latest 27.3 betas bring a bunch of changes including face unlock on iPhone Duo and redesigned Full Disk Access on Mac.

And in Happy Hour Plus, there’s a rumor Apple is going to ditch the Action button on future iPhones. Benjamin doesn’t believe it. Subscribe at 9to5mac.com/join.
